title: Cut lore 0.4.6
description: LCLI-455 fixes a real, urgent break: Quest 0.4.0's non-terminal Blocked status would crash lore sync/lore check the moment a linked task was paused. quest-cli holds their own quest 0.4.0 npm publish until lore 0.4.6 carrying this fix is live on the registry. Version bump 0.4.5 -> 0.4.6 across package.json, all six npm/<platform>/package.json manifests, the six optionalDependencies pins, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json; regenerate bun.lock under the pinned Bun; refresh the three version-bearing Ladybug digest baselines; move CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] under [0.4.6]; update README version-status line.

acceptanceCriteria.text: package.json, all six npm/<platform>/package.json, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json all read 0.4.6
root optionalDependencies pins all six platform packages at 0.4.6
bun install --frozen-lockfile succeeds against the pinned Bun version
Ladybug fixture/report digest tests pass with only canonicalExportSha256 moved (proven by negative control)
dev promoted to main via fast-forward push, confirmed by git rev-parse equality
tag v0.4.6 points at the promoted commit
release.yml dispatched with publish:true and all seven packages resolve at 0.4.6 on the public registry
plugin.json at the tag reads 0.4.6, matching the marketplace pin

implementationNotes: Released. Tag v0.4.6 at e98e217 (fast-forward from 70d61df, verified by git rev-parse equality on main/dev). PR #605 promotion ran the full main-triggered CI matrix, all green. Release run 34131804527 dispatched with publish:true, all seven packages published via npm OIDC trusted publishing; registry verified all seven at 0.4.6 latest (lore-linux-arm64 briefly lagged at 0.4.5 for ~35s, resolved -- job log confirmed npm's own success confirmation printed at time of publish, same benign pattern recorded for 0.4.0-0.4.5). Clean npm install smoke returned 0.4.6. plugin.json at the tag reads 0.4.6.
